study type: Validation study using retrospective cohort data
exposure: International Classification of Diseases (ICD) codes for chorioamnionitis
outcome: Clinical or histologic chorioamnionitis diagnosis (reference standard)
cohort: The study included a cohort of live deliveries at two United States military hospitals from 2013 to 2018.
finding: Chorioamnionitis ICD codes exhibited moderate correlation with clinical disease (PPV of 0.68, sensitivity of 0.76) and with clinical or histologic disease (PPV of 0.75), suggesting challenges in using medical encounter data to isolate clinical cases from those only identified through laboratory testing.
